en.topic_title: Flags lowered nationwide for funeral of China’s ex-premier Zhu Rongji
en.topic_summary:
Former Chinese premier Zhu Rongji was mourned on Tuesday with lowered flags and social media commemorations, ahead of a funeral for the reforming trailblazer who died last week at 97.



A Chinese national flag is pictured at half mast to mourn the death of China’s former premier Zhu Rongji in Beijing on August 18, 2026. Photo: Adek Berry/AFP.
